description: This file contains unit tests for the AgentWorkspace component, focusing on path handling, bootstrap file creation, and workspace safety checks.

classes.name: AgentWorkspaceTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests for the AgentWorkspace functionalities.

methods.name: display path uses tilde for home
methods.description: Tests that the displayPath method correctly represents the home directory with a tilde.

methods.name: resolve workspace URL expands tilde
methods.description: Verifies that resolveWorkspaceURL correctly expands a tilde to the user's home directory.

methods.name: agents URL appends filename
methods.description: Checks that the agentsURL method appends the correct filename to the workspace URL.

methods.name: bootstrap creates agents file when missing
methods.description: Ensures that bootstrap creates necessary files when absent and verifies their existence.

methods.name: bootstrap safety rejects non empty folder without agents
methods.description: Tests that bootstrapSafety returns unsafe reason when folder isn't empty and lacks agent files.

methods.name: bootstrap safety allows existing agents file
methods.description: Verifies that bootstrapSafety allows continuation if agents file already exists.

methods.name: bootstrap skips bootstrap file when workspace has content
methods.description: Checks that bootstrap doesn't recreate bootstrap file if the workspace already has content.

methods.name: needs bootstrap false when identity already set
methods.description: Validates that the workspace does not need bootstrap if identity info is already present.
